1986. Safe Division Checker

90

Hard

Problem Statement

Given two integers, divide the first by the second. Handle the case where the divisor is zero using exception handling instead of letting the program crash.

Description

Read two integers a and b from input, one per line. Divide a by b and print the quotient. If b is zero, print an error message instead of the result.
input_spec:
, one per line. Divide a by b and print the quotient. If b is zero, print an error message instead of the result.

Input Description

Two lines, each containing an integer: a and b (-1000 ≤ a, b ≤ 1000)
output_spec: Print the quotient of a divided by b. If b is zero, print "Error: Division by zero not allowed" instead.
